readme_excerpt: WhisperX Recall.ai - Meeting Transcription API If you’re looking for a transcription API for meetings, consider checking out Recall.ai's Meeting Transcription API, an API that works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and more. Recall.ai diarizes by pulling the speaker data and separate audio streams from the meeting platforms, which means 100% accurate speaker diarization with actual speaker names.
